description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve books from predefined shelves such as 'To Read', 'Reading', 'Read', and 'Did Not Finish'. It uses a BookService to fetch data related to specific ShelfName enums.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfController
classes.description: Spring REST controller exposing endpoints for retrieving books from predefined shelves.

methods.name: getAllToReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve books marked as 'To Read' from the predefined shelf.

methods.name: getAllReadingBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve books currently being read.

methods.name: getAllReadBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve books that have been read.

methods.name: getAllDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve books that were not finished.
